topics.topic: Preservation and Compilation of the Holy Quran: Caliph Abu Bakr and Uthman (RA)
learningObjectives: Detail oral memorization and recording of revelations on parchment, stones, and shoulder bones under Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
Explain the compilation of the first unified Mushaf by Zayd ibn Thabit under Caliph Abu Bakr following the Battle of Yamama
Analyze the standardization and distribution of the Uthmanic codex across Islamic provinces to eliminate dialectal divergences

topics.topic: Quranic Exegesis: Study, recitation, and translation of Suratul Hujurat (Quran 49:1-10)
learningObjectives: Recite verses 1-10 of Suratul Hujurat with proper application of Tajweed rules
Translate Arabic text and explain the context of revelation (Asbab an-Nuzul)
Derive ethical lessons on respecting leadership, verifying rumors, and reconciling disputing brethren

topics.topic: Quranic Exegesis: Suratul Hujurat (Quran 49:11-18) on social decorum and brotherhood
learningObjectives: Recite verses 11-18 with Tajweed and translate into clear English
Examine divine prohibitions against defamation, mocking, offensive nicknames, suspicion, and backbiting
Analyze verse 13 establishing universal human brotherhood and declaring Taqwa (piety) as the sole criterion of nobility

topics.topic: Hadith Studies: Sincerity in intentions (Hadith 1 of An-Nawawi) and science of Hadith
learningObjectives: Differentiate between Sanad (chain of narrators) and Matn (textual content) in Hadith scholarship
Recite, translate, and comment on Hadith 1 ('Actions are judged by intentions')
Apply sincerity (Ikhlas) to acts of worship, academic study, and social interaction

topics.topic: Tawheed (Islamic Monotheism): Three categories (Rububiyyah, Uluhiyyah, Asma wa Sifat)
learningObjectives: Explain Tawheed ar-Rububiyyah (Unity of Lordship, creation, and sustenance)
Explain Tawheed al-Uluhiyyah (Unity of Worship and devotion)
Explain Tawheed al-Asma was-Sifat (Affirmation of Allah's Beautiful Names and Attributes without anthropomorphism)
Identify forms of major Shirk (polytheism) and minor Shirk (Riya/showing off)

topics.topic: Taharah (Purification): Ghusl (ritual bath), Tayammum (dry ablution), and cleanliness
learningObjectives: State circumstances obligating Ghusl (post-marital intercourse, menses, post-natal bleeding)
Demonstrate step-by-step performance of major ablution (Ghusl) according to the Sunnah
Explain conditions permitting Tayammum and demonstrate its performance on clean earth

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Quranic Recitation Diagnostic Test
learningObjectives: Evaluate pupil mastery of Suratul Hujurat exegesis, Hadith terminology, and Tawheed
Conduct individualized oral Tajweed recitation examinations
Provide remedial coaching on Hadith memorization and theological distinctions

topics.topic: Zakat and Sadaqah: Economic empowerment, social equity, and poverty eradication
learningObjectives: Define Zakat as the third pillar of Islam and differentiate it from voluntary charity (Sadaqah)
Calculate Nisab (minimum taxable threshold) and rates (2.5%) for gold, silver, and commercial merchandise
Enumerate the eight statutory categories of Zakat recipients specified in Surah at-Tawbah (9:60)

topics.topic: Sirah: The Makkan Period, persecution of early Muslims, and Boycott of Banu Hashim
learningObjectives: Trace the secret and open call to Islam in Makkah and early converts
Examine the brutal persecution endured by Bilal, Yasir, Sumayyah, and Khabbab
Analyze the three-year socio-economic boycott of Banu Hashim in the valley of Shi'b Abi Talib

topics.topic: Sirah: The Hijrah to Abyssinia and the Landmark Migration (Hijrah) to Madinah (622 CE)
learningObjectives: Examine the two migrations to Abyssinia and Ja'far ibn Abi Talib's eloquent defense before King Negus
Analyze the Pledges of al-Aqabah with the Ansar of Yathrib
Detail the dramatic escape from Makkah, stay in the Cave of Thawr, and arrival in Madinah initiating the Islamic calendar

topics.topic: Islamic Moral Ethics: Truthfulness (Sidq), honesty, kindness to parents (Birr al-Walidayn)
learningObjectives: State Quranic and prophetic injunctions regarding unflinching truthfulness in speech and business
Explain filial piety and the divine prohibition against saying even 'Fie' (Uff) to parents (Quran 17:23)
Contrast Islamic moral virtues with prevalent social vices like dishonesty and disrespect

topics.topic: Comprehensive IRS Revision & WAEC Past Question Clinic
learningObjectives: Review key Quranic texts, Hadith narrations, Tawheed, and historical Sirah milestones
Practice constructing structured essay answers conforming to WAEC Paper 2 rubric specifications
Audit student precision in Arabic transliteration and scriptural references

topics.topic: Terminal Examination, Paper Moderation and Score Recording
learningObjectives: Administer official SSS 1 IRS theory and objective examination papers
Score scripts in strict compliance with West African Examinations Council marking guidelines
Record and publish verified student marks for academic broadsheet compilation
